'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 Joe Pinto LS An Unusual Amount Of Fear''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Pinto]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
